steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.description: 30–45 min call to understand your business, current process and goal. Not a 'sales meeting', it's a technical conversation to see if it makes sense to work together.

steps.title: Proposal and scope
steps.description: Within 3 days, you receive a structured proposal with clear scope, realistic timeline and detailed investment. No surprises along the way.

steps.title: Kick-off
steps.description: Final alignment of expectations, definition of delivery milestones and configuration of tracking tools.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Work in short sprints (1–2 weeks) with partial deliveries so you can track progress and give feedback.

steps.title: Delivery and testing
steps.description: Final review, quality tests, adjustments and production deployment.

steps.title: Initial support
steps.description: 30 days warranty for adjustments and questions. After that, monthly maintenance plans available.
